en: How do I set opening hours and an away message?

steps: Add one or two periods per day (past-midnight allowed)
Away message in Arabic and English
Choose whether the bot and agent keep taking orders while closed
edgeCases: Away message sent once per closed period
ordersWhileClosed=off: away message replaces bot and agent
gaps: Single timezone (Africa/Cairo) only; no holidays/Ramadan special hours
